metadata.what: Land polygons (S-57 LNDARE) around Corpus Christi TX. Validator rule: WATER if inside any water_overrides_local.geojson polygon (Oso Bay); else LAND if inside any feature here (even-odd per polygon); else WATER (incl. intertidal flats). See SOURCES_land.md.
metadata.bands: harbour = NOAA band-5 ENC cells (0.075 deg tiles) inside 27 tiles covering the ship channel, CC Bay north half, Nueces Bay south half, Aransas Pass, Redfish/Aransas Bay, Rockport, GIWW in upper Laguna Madre; coastal = band-3 ENC cells US3TX1CA/CB/BA clipped to everything outside those tiles.
metadata.note: Straight edges on 0.075-deg tile lines and on the extent box are cut lines, not shoreline.
